next_phase.why: Multi-agent maturity audit (run wf_ebc554f3-006; aborted on schema cap but 4/5 reviewers completed, unanimous, recovered from transcripts) confirmed the user's critique: Backtester=usable, Optimizer=amateur, ML Pattern Finder=amateur/toy. ML trains on RAW absolute features (metrics.enrich_trades ~L73-89; ml/patterns.py) that don't generalize across instruments/asset-classes; no holdout/significance; bulk mode concatenates different-scale instruments.
next_phase.fix_thesis: Make features RELATIVE/NORMALIZED & comparable (validated, unanimous): volume/SMA20(volume), EMA slope in ATR units, distance-from-MA in ATR, z-score, rolling percentile rank, n-bar return. Implement as NEW INDICATOR TYPES in the registry so builder + ML + plotter all get them via the single-source pipeline. Then add ML holdout + Wilson/BH-FDR significance, then optimizer validation (Deflated Sharpe, parameter-stability heatmap, walk-forward, Monte-Carlo).

phases.A_normalized_feature_library: DONE (2026-06-27): 6 new indicator types added — 'Ratio to SMA' (x/SMA, use Volume source for volume-vs-avg), 'Distance from MA (ATR)', 'MA Slope (ATR)', 'Z-Score', 'Percentile Rank', 'Return (n-bar)'. Implemented via config.INDICATOR_PLACEMENT(panel)/PANEL_GUIDES + indicators.INDICATOR_TYPES/PARAM_SPECS + 6 vectorised helpers (ratio_to_sma_vec/dist_from_ma_atr_vec/ma_slope_atr_vec/zscore_vec/pctile_rank_vec/ret_n_vec) + emit_indicator branches + compiler._namespace injection. Builder/ML/plotter all get them via the single-source pipeline; they render in own panels (v6.1). tests/test_features.py (4 tests: formula match, panel placement, codegen+compile+backtest, cross-asset comparability). Full suite 45/45 green.
phases.B_ml_rigor: ml/patterns.py + ml_finder.py: default to normalized features; per-instrument normalization before bulk concat; time-ordered holdout/k-fold; per-rule Wilson lower-bound + binomial vs baseline + Benjamini-Hochberg FDR + sample-size floor. Effort M.
phases.C_optimizer_validation: metrics: Deflated/Probabilistic Sharpe; optimizer: surface grid return_heatmap (currently discarded) for parameter stability; new backtest/wfo.py walk-forward; Monte-Carlo bootstrap bands. Effort M-L.

next_phase.release_framing: v7.0 = Phase A + B (the user's core complaint); v7.1 = Phase C.
next_phase.implementation_pattern: Reuse the proven ALMA/LR-Slope/R2 approach: vectorised helper in indicators.py + inject into compiler._namespace() + emit via self.I. architecture.entry: app_main.py (thin: page config, auth sidebar, nav radio, dispatch to one render(ctx) page module; per-page auth gate; session-cached master_df + precomputed selector meta)
architecture.quantdesk/config.py: env/paths/constants; DEFAULTS (incl save_format='Both', csv_data_dir, quality thresholds); INDICATOR_OUTPUT_SUFFIXES; INDICATOR_PLACEMENT (overlay/panel) + INDICATOR_PANEL_GUIDES
architecture.quantdesk/core: db (single SQLite layer + migration + insert_backtest), settings_repo (cached), logging, cache (Streamlit-or-not shim: cache_data/cache_resource), reproducibility (hashes)
architecture.quantdesk/data: loader (csv/parquet, mtime cache), resample (vectorised per-session), corporate_actions (dtype-safe splits), master_list (cache_resource + vectorised classifier + 24h disk cache), quality (gate), recovery, saver (Parquet/CSV/Both + separate csv dir)
architecture.quantdesk/brokers: base, upstox/zerodha/dhan (fetch_single + upstox options), downloader (async orchestrator, progress_cb)
architecture.quantdesk/strategy: models (StrategyConfig, safe_name, selectable_columns, classify_columns), indicators (registry+codegen+param specs+vectorised ALMA/LRSlope/R2; USE_VECTORIZED flag), codegen (build_strategy_code), compiler (bytecode-cached fresh class), presets
architecture.quantdesk/backtest: worker (ProcessPool, quality gate, buried metrics), engine (run_single + IS/OOS split + native_bokeh_html), optimizer (Optuna+grid, int-safe), batch (folder multi-core + extract_trades), metrics (stats + buried + equity_returns + yearly + enrich_trades)
architecture.quantdesk/viz/charts.py: render_plotly_backtest (multi-panel: overlays on price, oscillators in own panels w/ guides, Scattergl, candle downsample, intraday rangebreaks), equity_overlay, feature_importance_bar, quantstats tearsheet+metrics
architecture.quantdesk/ui: components (auth sidebar, instrument selector w/ precomputed meta, render_save_folders, PageContext) + pages/* (13 render(ctx) modules)

key_decisions: Keep backtesting.py as the engine (do NOT swap to NautilusTrader/VectorBT).

Keep Plotly for charts; do NOT pivot to Bokeh or TradingView Lightweight Charts (multi-agent debate verdict: messiness was a DESIGN bug, fixed in v6.1; st.bokeh_chart is a no-op in Streamlit 1.58; LWC is a third-party iframe with quirks). Optional native-Bokeh 'Pro chart' embed kept behind a toggle only.
Indicator placement (overlay vs own panel) is single-sourced in config.INDICATOR_PLACEMENT.
Default download save format = Both (Parquet + CSV); CSV can go to a separate folder.
Vectorised indicators are proven byte-equal to originals (test_parity.py); toggle via indicators.USE_VECTORIZED.
Local tools work without broker login; only live downloaders/options need auth.
modular.json is the granular file-by-file index, updated via .workflow/modlog.py (env MODLOG_AGENT=name; commands: file/log/feature/speed/phase/agent).
gotchas: pandas >= 3: in-place float assignment into an int64 column raises (fixed corporate_actions by casting OHLCV to float first).
ML per-trade return column is 'ReturnPct' (fraction), NOT 'Return [%]' (that's overall stats).
backtesting.py Position has NO .entry_price; use self.trades[-1].entry_price (trailing-stop codegen).
_prev_position_size is SIGNED (negative for shorts) — short trailing fresh-entry guard is '>= 0'.
st.cache_data deep-copies its return each rerun; master list uses cache_resource + session_state to avoid 53MB copies.
Headless Chrome in this sandbox cannot screenshot Plotly/canvas (kaleido fails to launch Chrome); rely on AppTest + structural tests; use a real browser for visual confirmation.
Streamlit st.bokeh_chart is a no-op in 1.58; embed Bokeh via components.html(file_html(...)).
Tests hardcode the D:\simpleton data path (not portable to CI/other machines) — a known deferred item.
Windows multiprocessing: spawn children import the worker module; run ProcessPool tests via a real .py with __main__ guard (tests/manual_batch_check.py), not heredoc.
completed_in_v6_and_v6_1: PERF: master-list cache_resource + session_state + vectorised classifier (3.0s->0.3s) + 24h disk cache (startup ~10s->0.8s); selector per-class slices (keystroke ~90ms->33ms); WAL once; resample vectorised.
